title: Man who stabbed passengers on train to London guilty of attempted murder of 14 people
summary_full: Anthony Williams stabbed two boys before assault on rail passengers in ‘ferocious and frenzied’ attack over 25 hoursA 33-year-old man has been found guilty of attempted murder in a “ferocious and frenzied attack” in which he stabbed 14 people, including 10 passengers at random on a London-bound train last year.Anthony Williams of Peterborough admitted stabbing 14 people, including two boys, in 25 hours on 31 October and 1 November 2025. Ten people were attacked on an LNER service from Doncaster to London. Continue reading...
